title: Santoshi Maa
desc: Santoshi Maa suspects that Indra has disguised himself in the form of an unknown bird or animal. Meanwhile, Guddu is eager to sell his share of the house and maximize his earnings from it.

title: Jodha Akbar
desc: During the 16th century, Emperor Akbar secures a crucial alliance through his marriage to Jodha, a princess from the esteemed Rajput dynasty.

title: Kundali Bhagya
desc: The Arora family bets on Preeta's future husband. Meanwhile, Preeta confronts Deepak and forcefully rejects his advances.

title: Vasudha
desc: Chandrika restores Hanumant's job but enforces strict boundaries to limit Vasudha. While they adjust, Sarika senses hidden danger upon hearing Gulki barking.

title: Saru
desc: Saru is sent to Mumbai by Sitaram, but Gouri attempts to intervene. Suddenly, Sitaram's health declines rapidly, and with his last breath, he secures a promise from Gouri.

title: Jagriti - Ek Nayi Subah
desc: Kalikant controls Mokshgarh's Chitta community. However, Harish rescues a pregnant Geeta from Kalikant's grasp, and they escape, welcoming a baby girl.

title: Bhagya Lakshmi
desc: Rano successfully convinces Lakshmi to avoid calling off the upcoming nuptials. Later, Rishi inadvertently drops a precious ancestral necklace that falls perfectly onto Lakshmi's neck.

title: Jaane Anjaane Hum Mile
desc: Once Reet consents to wed Raghav, Raghav releases Dhruv. Later, Reet prevents Veeren from acting improperly towards Poonam.

title: Vasudha
desc: Things get out of control as Kavita and Karishma arrive at the Chauhan mansion. Later, Avinash and Devansh save the day for Vasudha.

title: Saru
desc: Saru encounters considerable difficulty in locating her college. As a result, she makes the decision to go to the temple.
